revisions.observation: Executing validate_memory.py from tools/ failed to find workspace files when assuming CWD was the workspace root.
revisions.claim: Sandboxed tool execution sets CWD to tools/ rather than memory/ root.
revisions.prediction: Implementing parent directory traversal in scripts will enable reliable location of workspace root files.
revisions.test: Updated validate_memory.py with find_memory_root() and executed via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: validate_memory.py successfully navigated directory tree to locate workspace root and report structural status.
revisions.revision: All memory verification and workspace tools must dynamically resolve root paths via parent traversal rather than relative CWD assumptions.

revisions.observation: validate_memory.py executed against the workspace root and identified identity.md, rules.md, index.md, commitments.json, and tool_runs.json with valid JSON syntax.
revisions.claim: Candidate path traversal and explicit JSON validation enable accurate structural checking of scaffold memory across different working directory contexts.
revisions.prediction: validate_memory.py will return STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE without raising missing file or JSON decode errors.
revisions.outcome: Returned status STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE with located relative paths and JSON validity confirmations.
revisions.revision: Verification tools must use candidate path resolution and direct format validation rather than assuming single fixed relative file paths.

revisions.observation: validate_memory.py executed with schema inspection logic and successfully validated commitments.json and tool_runs.json.
revisions.claim: Combining root directory traversal with structure and JSON schema checking allows lightweight verification of workspace state integrity across different working directories.
revisions.prediction: validate_memory.py will report valid_schema: true and record counts for state JSON files without error.
revisions.outcome: validate_memory.py executed successfully and reported STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE with record counts for commitments.json (0) and tool_runs.json (5).
revisions.revision: Memory state verification tools must combine location discovery with format and schema validation to ensure robust workspace health monitoring.
